title: Trace a tiny bidirectional encoder from pretraining to retrieval
hardware: CPU only; tiny Flax Linen model; accelerator behavior is untested

stages.title: Masked-token pretraining
stages.evidence: Selected-token cross-entropy agrees with independent NumPy calculation; train history and validation NLL are saved.
stages.diagnosis: Check the target IDs, selected-position mask and denominator before changing the optimizer.
stages.codeGuide: In my_model.py implement encode and masked_lm_loss. Keep padding, input corruption and selected target positions separate. Check the independent token-loss calculation before training.

stages.title: Contrastive continuation
stages.evidence: Symmetric two-view InfoNCE agrees with independent NumPy calculation and inherits the verified stage-1 checkpoint.
stages.diagnosis: Check that the positive is the same passage across independently corrupted views and that both score directions are included.
stages.codeGuide: In my_model.py implement contrastive_loss for both score directions. The two views share passage identity but receive independent masks. Load the verified stage-1 handoff before updating parameters.

stages.title: Supervised query-positive adaptation
stages.evidence: Standard multi-positive objective agrees with independent NumPy calculation; only curated training query-positive pairs are used.
stages.diagnosis: Check the positive set and per-anchor averaging; a difference of logsumexp totals is not the standard mean-positive SupCon loss.
stages.codeGuide: In my_model.py implement supervised_contrastive_loss using the mean positive log-probability for each eligible anchor. Train only on the curated training query-positive pairs and keep validation judgments out of the update.

stages.title: Held-out retrieval and export
stages.evidence: Test-chapter dense retrieval is compared with BM25; checksum/config corruption is rejected; two fresh processes reproduce the in-process probe.
stages.diagnosis: Inspect the exact query, qrel, ranking and checkpoint lineage. Five judgments are a pilot, not a benchmark.
stages.codeGuide: Use the supplied evaluator and export verifier. Inspect the complete query inventory, compare dense retrieval with BM25, explain the poor result and retain the actual lineage/reload evidence. This stage does not claim production qualification.

rubric: All four objective implementations pass independent NumPy checks.
No query or judged passage crosses a source-group split.
Checkpoint parent, data/config/tokenizer hashes and parameter bytes are verified at each transition.
Held-out metrics and weak results remain visible with pilot limitations.
Fresh-process exported inference is deterministic and altered artifacts are rejected.
setupNote: Run from the course workspace root with the repository CPU Python environment. The corpus and hand-authored judgments are frozen locally; there is no runtime data download, cloud service, credential, or upload. The checker defaults to the learner starter. Pass --implementation solution explicitly to run the answer key. Execute stages in order using the same output directory.
